fields.name: Velvet Reverie
fields.description: Dark, velvety bouquets in burgundy, plum and antique rose — callas, speckled lilies, peonies and glossy black anthuriums, romantic and a little mysterious, like an old master's still life.

fields.name: Tender Ruins
fields.description: Airy, weightless compositions in muted lilac, cream and fading pink, with unusual petal shapes — beauty that is softly falling apart.

fields.name: Love Letters
fields.description: Speckled oriental lilies against deep plum callas, berried branches and cascading amaranthus. Written in velvet and ink — a bouquet that says everything you couldn't.

fields.name: Fallen Angel
fields.description: Dusty mauve garden roses, wine-red anemones and soft lisianthus, loosened with wild greenery. Tender and romantic, with just a touch of darkness.

fields.name: Ophelia
fields.description: Spotted lilies, hellebores and ivory callas drifting through berries and Queen Anne's lace. A painterly, melancholic bouquet straight out of an old master's still life.

fields.name: Dark Desire
fields.description: Deep burgundy peonies with sweet peas, scabiosa and speckled orchids. Lush, heady and unapologetically sensual.

fields.name: Eternal Bloom
fields.description: White anemones, burgundy callas and a single antique rose, wrapped in black with a satin ribbon. A quiet promise that lasts.

fields.name: Faded Poetry
fields.description: Lilac-edged anemones, dusty pink garden roses and violet clematis in sheer cream paper, with berried twigs reaching out like lines of an old poem.

fields.name: Love in Silence
fields.description: Soft pink garden roses, lavender lisianthus and pale anemones, with a few wine-coloured clematis stars. A bouquet for the feelings you keep to yourself.

fields.name: Almost Yours
fields.description: Blush peonies, ivory ranunculus and ruffled sweet peas with wild grasses and eucalyptus. Light, hesitant and almost-confessed.

fields.name: Sunday Letters
fields.description: Mauve roses, dewy white anemones, lilac delphinium and clematis tied with frayed silk. Like rereading old letters on a slow Sunday morning.

fields.name: A Little Heartache
fields.description: Peach garden roses, antique-pink carnations, hellebores and drooping parrot tulips among blossoming branches. Beautiful, a little sad, and very honest.

fields.name: Before We Met
fields.description: White cosmos, blush garden roses, sweet peas and scabiosa spilling out of crinkled paper. Wild and full of the feeling that something lovely is about to begin.

fields.name: Dark Eden
fields.description: Glossy black anthuriums, burgundy lilies and button chrysanthemums with eucalyptus and trailing amaranthus. Strange, sculptural and impossible to look away from.

fields.name: First Love
fields.description: Soft blush, peach, butter yellow and a touch of baby blue in sunlit paper — light, a little shy and full of hope, like the first time you fell for someone.

fields.name: Butterflies
fields.description: Ivory tulips, pink sweet peas and lilac lisianthus with lacy Queen Anne's lace in blush paper. Exactly how it feels when they text you back.

fields.name: Dear Juliet
fields.description: White lilies, a peach dahlia and ruffled pink carnations with astilbe and fern. A classic love story — tender, a little theatrical, and completely sincere.

fields.name: Blushing
fields.description: Creamy peonies, dusty pink garden roses and apricot ranunculus with sweet peas and baby's breath. Soft, rosy and impossible not to smile at.

fields.name: Blue Valentine
fields.description: A cloud of pale blue hydrangea with blush garden roses, white cosmos, delphinium and trailing ivy. For someone who lives a little bit in the clouds.

fields.name: Golden Hour
fields.description: Butter-yellow ranunculus, blush peonies and white stock with olive branches, wrapped in raw linen paper. Warm light, long evenings, easy laughter.

fields.name: First Kiss
fields.description: Peach garden roses, blush anemones and ivory spray roses with eucalyptus and sweet peas. Sweet, warm and a little breathless.

fields.name: Strange Eden
fields.description: An all-green collection of amaryllis, anthuriums, parrot tulips and green orchids on stone and silk — strange, sculptural and quietly botanical.

fields.name: Green Reverie
fields.description: Veined white-and-green amaryllis, lime hydrangea and frilled green carnations with white larkspur, tied with olive silk. Calm, cool and dreamy.

fields.name: Poison Ivy
fields.description: Striped amaryllis, glossy green anthuriums, pale carnations and starry stephanotis on long trailing stems. Pretty — and just a little poisonous.

fields.name: Moss & Marble
fields.description: Green cymbidium orchids, ruffled parrot tulips, anthurium and chartreuse hydrangea with Queen Anne's lace. Soft moss against cold stone.

fields.name: Secret Garden
fields.description: Deep green anthuriums, parrot tulips and speckled orchids with hanging amaranthus and climbing vines. A hidden place only you know the way to.

fields.name: Botanical Affair
fields.description: Green parrot tulips, a pale anthurium and white sweet peas with green amaranthus and wild umbels. An old-fashioned romance, written in leaves.

fields.name: Wild Poetry
fields.description: Loose, hand-gathered bouquets of meadow flowers, poppies, grasses and climbing clematis, tied with raw linen — as if picked on a long walk and written down as a poem.

fields.name: Meadow Whisper
fields.description: Daisies, cornflowers, bellflowers and Queen Anne's lace, loosely tied with linen ribbon. A summer meadow in the late-afternoon sun.

fields.name: Forgotten Letters
fields.description: Lilac scabiosa, white cosmos, nodding clematis bells and feathery grasses in faded paper. Soft and wistful, like letters found in an old drawer.

fields.name: Autumn Muse
fields.description: Terracotta and rust Icelandic poppies, a single ivory poppy, chamomile and autumn grasses on a bare branch. Warm, wild and a little bittersweet.

fields.name: Silver Morning
fields.description: Silver dusty miller, white poppies, green hellebores and clematis in a stone urn, with drifting umbels and grasses. Cool, pale and calm as early light.

fields.name: Untamed Heart
fields.description: Lilac, white poppies and purple clematis on long arching branches that go wherever they want. For a heart that refuses to be tamed.

fields.name: Secret Meadow
fields.description: Pink wild roses, spotted foxgloves, buttercups and fern in kraft paper, gathered at the edge of the woods. A hidden garden in full bloom.
